about.title: About Us
about.intro: “أنا وأمي” (Mommy & me) is a specialized pediatric clinic and breastfeeding consultation center, led by a certified IBCLC consultant. We are fully dedicated to the health and well-being of both mothers and their babies.
about.philosophy: Our clinic offers a unique and holistic approach focused on guidance, education, and individualized care during the most delicate and transformative moments in a family's life.
about.pediatrics.title: Pediatric Consultations
about.pediatrics.text: Consultations are led by Dr. Ouddah and her husband, Dr. Nacef, who provide expert care for infants and children. They ensure healthy growth and early detection of concerns.
about.breastfeeding.title: Breastfeeding Support
about.breastfeeding.text: Our breastfeeding support is led by Dr. Ouddah, a certified IBCLC specialist with extensive expertise in helping mothers succeed in their breastfeeding journey. Whether you are facing latching difficulties, low milk supply, or emotional challenges, Dr. Ouddah provides personalized, evidence-based guidance to ensure the best outcomes for both mother and baby.
about.maternal.title: Maternal Well-being
about.maternal.text: We believe that supporting the mother is essential to supporting the child. Our care includes listening, emotional support, and personalized advice.
about.education.title: Parent Education
about.education.text: Workshops and individual sessions help parents better understand newborn behavior, nutrition, and healthy parenting practices.
